entry.title: New: inspiration-deck-workshop#dsh-inspiration-deck-workshop
entry.summary: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies. Exact install spec: dsh-inspiration-deck-workshop. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
